title: Create real-time voice pipeline POC script + README + launcher
completion_summary: Created voice pipeline POC: Python script, PowerShell launcher, and README
acceptance_criteria: Python script starts llama-server with a cached GGUF model from F:\.cache\huggingface\hub\models
Script runs faster-whisper for STT and Kokoro-82M for TTS using cached checkpoints
Real-time loop reads audio, transcribes, generates response, synthesizes, plays audio
Launcher script configures paths to installed llama.cpp (F:\llama-win-cuda-13.3, F:\llama_cpp, F:\llama.cpp)
README explains setup, model caching, and how to run the launcher
